# Verify and explain

Choose a retained variant and replace `YOUR_VARIANT_ID`:

```bash
python scripts/python/verify_variant.py data/my-study results/my-study YOUR_VARIANT_ID
```

Check beta sign against the effect allele, confidence intervals against SE, and source p-values against the source test definition. Reconcile discrepancies instead of editing outputs to match expectations.

Write observations containing a variant ID, effect allele, units, checked number and limitation. A genome-wide association is not a clinical diagnosis or proof of causation.
